Speaker: Gao
Content: Father, you said you'd come straight back... Where are you?
ChineseContent: 爹，你说拿到刀就回来……你到底去哪儿了？

Speaker: Gao
Content: Three days... Someone must have seen you.
ChineseContent: 已经三天了……总得有人见过你。

Speaker: Fox
ChineseContent: 你在找<color=#FFDC88>俄高勒</color>？

Speaker: Fox
ChineseContent: 你是他的儿子，<color=#FFDC88>高勒趣</color>吧？

Speaker: Gao
Content: You've seen my father? Where did he go?
ChineseContent: 你见过我父亲？他到哪里去了？

Speaker: Fox
ChineseContent: 我见过。他被<color=#FFDC88>署</color>带走了。

Speaker: Fox
Content: That boar you hunted belonged to Shu.
ChineseContent: 你们猎杀的那头野猪，是署的。

Speaker: Gao
Content: Shu? But we hunted it together...
ChineseContent: 署？可那头野猪是我们一起猎的……

Speaker: Fox
Content: Egaole is held on <color=#9876C5>the fifth hill</color>. You've only reached the first.
ChineseContent: 俄高勒被关在<color=#9876C5>第五座山</color>上。你才走到第一座。

Speaker: Fox
Content: Go and find him. But this time, don't leave the forest wounded behind you.
ChineseContent: 去找他吧。只是这一次，别再让山林因你们受伤。

Speaker: Gao
ChineseContent: 它消失了……

Speaker: Gao
Content: My father often said that, the south slope is sunny, the north valley is shady.
ChineseContent: 父亲常说，南坡向阳，北谷背阴。

Speaker: Gao
Content: White belongs <color=#FFDC88>above</color>. Black belongs <color=#FFDC88>below</color>. I must remember that.
ChineseContent: 白的归于<color=#FFDC88>高处</color>，黑的归于<color=#FFDC88>低处</color>。这句话，我得记住。

Speaker: Gao
Content: The snakes are twisting with each other, I can't pass through this way…
ChineseContent: 两条蛇缠在一起，挡住了去路……

Speaker: Gao
ChineseContent: 那个，能不能请你们……

Speaker: Gao
ChineseContent: 啊，谢谢。

Speaker: Gao
Content: The path is still blocked by these boulders.
ChineseContent: 这些巨石……还是把路堵住了。

Speaker: Gao
Content: They are apart now, but their eyes are still locked... Perhaps those red stones we passed could help.
ChineseContent: 他们分开了，目光却还缠在一起……刚才那些红色的石头，或许能派上用场。

Speaker: Gao
ChineseContent: 也许……狐狸说得对。

Speaker: Gao
Content: Sunlight reaches this hollow, above the path.
ChineseContent: 这里向阳，比山路高些。

Speaker: Gao
Content: This hollow lies lower, in the shade.
ChineseContent: 这里背阴，地势也低。

Speaker: Gao
Content: So many rocks, I'm definitely reaching the peak.
ChineseContent: 石头越来越多，应该快到山顶了。

Speaker: Gao
Content: If only something could stand between them, so they could no longer see each other...
ChineseContent: 要是有什么东西能隔在中间，让他们看不见彼此就好了……

Speaker: Gao
Content: Those red stones... perhaps I could push one between them.
ChineseContent: 那些红色的石头……或许能推过去试试。

Speaker: Gao
Content: Then their caves. Father said: <color=#FFDC88>white above, black below</color>.
ChineseContent: 然后是他们各自的洞。父亲说过：<color=#FFDC88>白的在高处，黑的在低处</color>。
